# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security problems in UpLa or in its upla.com.tr sign-in add-on (`Server/`) privately, not in a public issue:

1. Open the **Security** tab of this repository.
2. Click **Report a vulnerability**.
3. Describe the problem and, if possible, how to reproduce it.

Please give us reasonable time to fix the problem before it is disclosed publicly.

UpLa is based on [ShareX](https://github.com/ShareX/ShareX). Problems that also affect ShareX itself should be reported to the ShareX project as well.
